params.levels: 0..1 the 15 slider caps rise from the strip plates to the real attention weights from 'it' (bert-base-uncased, mean of 144 heads, 3 Nov 2026), staggered left to right
params.mix: 0..1 the bus bar fills left to right: one segment per channel, as wide as its weight (they add to 100 %)
params.swap: 0..1 the weights move from the 'too big' run to the 'too small' run (caps shift by under 0.4 points) and the 'big' cap turns red
params.tint: 0..1 the trophy cap takes its colour (blue); its bus segment is always blue
params.tints: 0..1 the suitcase cap takes its colour (dark); its bus segment is always dark
params.lit: 0..1 the cap of the word 'it' turns yellow
params.sink: 0..1 the end-marker cap and its bus segment turn yellow (23 % of the attention)
